feedback: This candidate responds directly to the failure in iteration 0 (R2B: 60 of 60 trials ended off track, mean max_error 0.062 to 0.067 m, against the 0.06 m limit; line_loss_events 1 to 2 per run). Its changes are: sensors widened to x = -0.05 to 0.05 (keeping the antisymmetric weights -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1 so the steering sign is unchanged), base_speed lowered from 1.6 to 1.4, kd raised from 0.2 to 0.3, and ki lowered from 0.1 to 0.05. kp stays at 4.0 and line_loss stays 'last_direction'. The geometry and controller values are all inside their contract limits. Nothing here predicts how it will race. The main reasoning is that survival matters more than speed: a run that stays on track and reaches full progress is worth far more than an early off-track exit, so a lower base speed is a reasonable trade. The main risk is that base_speed 1.4 may be too slow to finish under 3 s, so completion is uncertain even if the robot survives. Because iteration 0 has no approved candidate that ran well and there are many iterations left, this is the right build to race for telemetry. After the race: (a) if line_loss_events is near 0 and max_error is under 0.06 on the oval and s-bend, but completion_time is above 3 s or completed=0 with progress near 1, raise base_speed in small steps (1.5 to 1.6) and keep the wider sensors. (b) If max_error is still above 0.06 on the slalom, raise kp toward 5 as the hypothesis states, and keep kd at 0.3 to avoid added oscillation. (c) If steering_oscillation rises after the kd change, reduce kd back toward 0.2 before changing kp.
requested_changes: After race 1: if the robot survives (completion 0 but progress near 1, or completion 1) with line_loss_events near 0, raise controller.base_speed in steps (1.4 to 1.5 to 1.6) to reach completion_time under 3 s, keeping the wider sensor array.
After race 1: if max_error stays above 0.06 on the slalom, raise controller.kp from 4.0 to about 5.0 and keep kd at 0.3, since the wider spread should already have cut line-loss events.
After race 1: if steering_oscillation rises above the 0.14 to 0.17 range seen in iteration 0, lower controller.kd from 0.3 to 0.2 before changing kp or base_speed.
